mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_babysitter_availability (email, day_of_week, time_slot) VALUES (#{email}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{timeSlot})

INSERT INTO tbl_babysitter_profile (email, name, career_years, region, available_time, hourly_rate, intro, status) VALUES (#{email}, #{name}, #{careerYears}, #{region}, #{availableTime}, #{hourlyRate}, #{intro}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_babysitter_profile SET name = #{name}, career_years = #{careerYears}, region = #{region}, available_time = #{availableTime}, hourly_rate = #{hourlyRate}, intro = #{intro}, status = #{status}, mod_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.select:
SELECT email, name, career_years, region, available_time, hourly_rate, intro, status, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_babysitter_profile
ORDER BY reg_time DESC LIMIT #{search.size} OFFSET #{skip}
